newsitem.title: UK: Manganese up on positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: Manganese up on positive press comment.

text.p: Manganese Bronze Holdings Plc, manufacturer of the London black cab, saw its shares rise on Monday after upbeat comment in the Sunday Times newspaper's "Inside Track" column.
By 1155 GMT, Manganese Bronze shares were up 22-1/2 pence at 500p.
The paper highlighted last week's results from the company, showing first-half pre-tax profits up 62 percent to 4.1 million stg, which was well above analyst expectations.
"Manganese is well set on a strong growth path which will drive profits growth, and on this rating the shares are set to rise further," the newspaper said.
